title.zh: Bitcoin exchanges can reduce quantum exposure before a network upgrade
title.en: Bitcoin exchanges can reduce quantum exposure before a network upgrade

current_state.zh: Coinbase's post-quantum Bitcoin workshop with Stanford and Localhost Research ended without consensus on a quantum-safe approach, highlighting that exchanges and custodians can reduce public-key exposure now while draft BIP-360 and post-quantum signatures remain unresolved.
